prompt_text: Analyze Prompt667 final end-to-end unattended project run acceptance and propose a local-only stabilization and release documentation prompt. Preserve all safety constraints: no remote push, no PR creation, no merge, no destructive cleanup, no credential/cookie/browser-profile/.env/private-session access, and no arbitrary free-text prompt execution. Focus on documenting the bounded local autonomy boundary, operating procedures, evidence retention, and maintenance checks.
